Who I Am & What I Do

Hi, I’m Adhwaid.

Videographer and video editor specialising in Videography, Video Editing, Colour Grading and Commercial Content. Based in Kochi, I focus on complete visual stories for advertising and commercial work.

By pairing a clear creative vision with DaVinci Resolve colour workflows, I keep a project’s visual intent consistent from the first frame to the final export — balancing strong visuals, purposeful edits and a distinct mood.

This portfolio is a curated selection of work. For collaborations, freelance projects or full-time opportunities, feel free to get in touch.
